text: With the requirement locked, this lesson draws a hard written line around what V1 actually ships.
V1 ships the Warranty Claim scoped app, its ACL, the partner portal, Flow Designer routing, and the Scripted REST API.
Deferred and named, not dropped: automated parts-ordering, a website rebuild, and self-service for Brindlewood's own employees.
V1 is partners only -- internal employees need a different access model, not a smaller version of this one.
Next: the first real architecture decision -- a scoped app, and a real API.
